title: Location registry
description: Language-neutral geographic registry, loaded once and shared by every language and every content file. Referenced by id from prophets.*.json and muhammad.*.json.

id.description: Stable slug. Never renamed once published — content files reference it.

aliases.description: Alternative historical names per language, e.g. Yathrib for Medina.

zoom.description: Initial OpenStreetMap zoom. Chosen to match `precision` — never zoom a region-level pin to street level.

precision.description: How specific the coordinate is. Drives map zoom and whether a marker or a shaded area is drawn. `unlocated` = an attested place whose position cannot be fixed; it has no coordinates and is named in text only, never pinned.

certainty.description: How well the identification is supported. `traditional` = commonly accepted in the sirah literature but not independently fixed; `disputed` = sources disagree. The UI must visibly distinguish these.

image.description: Photo of the location, hosted by Wikimedia. Null where no faithful image was found — the UI must then render the panel without one rather than substitute a lookalike.

file.description: Commons file name, without the 'File:' prefix. The canonical identity of the image.

thumbUrl.description: Direct 1280px thumbnail on Wikimedia's CDN — the fast path.

filePath.description: Special:FilePath redirect — the resilient path. Survives thumbnail purges and re-uploads, and accepts a ?width= parameter. The UI falls back to this if thumbUrl fails.

descriptionUrl.description: Commons file page. The displayed credit must link here — required by CC BY / CC BY-SA.

credit.description: Author, as recorded on Commons. Must be displayed.

license.description: Free licence only: CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA or public domain. Verified at fetch time; the fetch script refuses anything else.
